# Supplier Code of Conduct

This Code applies to every supplier of goods or services to the Company and to
every subcontractor engaged by such a supplier.

## Labour standards

A supplier must not engage any person under the age of 16 in any part of its
operations, and must be able to demonstrate the age of every worker on
request.

A supplier must pay every worker at least the applicable statutory minimum
wage and must not withhold wages as a disciplinary measure.

Working hours must not exceed the maximum permitted by applicable law, and
overtime must be voluntary.

## Health and safety

A supplier must maintain a safe working environment and must record and
investigate every workplace injury.

Personal protective equipment must be provided at the supplier's own cost and
must never be charged to a worker.

## Environmental standards

A supplier must hold every permit required for its operations by applicable
environmental law and must produce a copy on request.

A supplier must report any spill, release or other environmental incident
affecting the goods or services supplied to the Company within 48 hours of
becoming aware of it.

## Audit and remediation

The Company may audit a supplier's compliance with this Code on reasonable
notice, either itself or through a third party.

Where an audit identifies a failure to comply, the supplier must agree a
remediation plan with the Company and must complete it within the period the
plan states.

Persistent failure to remediate is a material breach of every agreement
between the supplier and the Company.
